blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising approach to long-tail autonomous driving, but existing driving datasets provide limited supervision for connecting decision-critical visual evidence with reasoning and planning. We introduce AnchorReasoning, a visually grounded reasoning dataset built on WOD-E2E, containing 416,119 annotated frames and 395,379 decision-critical elements across four major categories and 19 fine-grained types. Each frame is organized as a visually grounded chain-of-thought (VG-CoT) that links decision-critical element identification and localization, element attributes and implications, driving-action rationale, and action and trajectory planning. We further develop a curriculum supervised fine-tuning strategy that progressively learns these hierarchical capabilities, together with an object-size-aware grounding metric for evaluating localization quality. Experiments across eight general-purpose, embodied-AI, and AV-specific backbones show that VG-CoT supervision improves grounded reasoning and trajectory prediction. Across models, 5-s ADE and FDE decrease by 7.84 and 11.86, while RFS Frame and Cluster improve by 1.66 and 1.70. These gains are achieved with 18.5 fewer reasoning tokens and 0.32 s/frame lower inference latency on average, demonstrating the value of visually grounded, decision-focused supervision for VLM reasoning and planning in long-tail autonomous driving.
blocks.zh: 远景语言模型(VLMs)为长尾自主驾驶提供了一个很有希望的方法,但现有的驱动数据集对于将决定关键视觉证据与推理和规划联系起来提供了有限的监督. 我们介绍了AnchorReasoning,这是一个基于WOD-E2E的视觉推理数据集,包含416,119个附加说明的框架和395,379个决定关键要素,分四大类和19个精细的种类。 每个框架都是作为视网膜思维链(VG-CoT)排列的,将决策关键要素的识别和本地化、要素属性和影响、驱动-行动原理以及行动和轨迹规划联系起来。 我们进一步制定有监督的微调战略,逐步学习这些分级能力,同时制定评价本地化质量的物体大小认识基数。 跨越8个一般用途的实验,内含-AI和AV特定骨干显示,VG-CoT监督改进了有根据的推理和轨迹预测. 在整个模型中,5s-ADE和FDE减少了7.84和11.86,而RFS框架和集群则改善了1.66和1.70. 通过18.5个推理符号和0.32 s/frame推论较低的推论平均延缓率,这些成就得以实现,这表明了视网膜、以决策为重点的监督在长尾自主驾驶中进行VLM推理和规划的价值。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent autonomous driving research has increasingly focused on addressing long-tail scenarios. These rare and complex situations often require a deeper understanding of the driving context and deliberate reasoning to derive appropriate behavioral plans. Vision-language models (VLMs), with their strong multimodal understanding and commonsense reasoning capabilities, have therefore emerged as a promising paradigm for handling such challenging scenarios ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . However, effectively harnessing these capabilities for long-tail driving largely depends on how the training data are organized.
blocks.zh: 最近的自主驱动研究越来越注重解决长尾情况。 这些罕见而复杂的情况往往需要更深入地理解驱动环境,并有意识地推理得出适当的行为计划. 因此,具有强烈的多式联运理解和常识推理能力的VLMs是处理这种具有挑战性的情景的一个很有希望的范例(Wang等人,2025年;Zhou等人,2026年)。 然而,有效地利用这些能力进行长尾驾驶主要取决于如何组织培训数据。

blocks.en: Early VLM-oriented driving datasets were primarily organized around scene descriptions or captioning annotations ( Kim et al., 2018 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) . Such annotations provide holistic supervision of the driving environment, enabling models to learn high-level scene semantics and contextual information. However, coarse scene-level descriptions provide limited supervision for fine-grained, object-centric understanding. More importantly, they provide little explicit guidance on how scene observations should be translated into driving decisions.
blocks.zh: 早期的VLM导向驱动数据集主要围绕场景描述或字幕说明组织(Kim等人,2018年;Liu等人,2023年). 这种说明全面监督了驱动环境,使模型能够学习高级场景语义和背景信息。 然而,粗糙的场景级别描述为精细的,以物体为中心的理解提供了有限的监督. 更重要的是,它们很少就如何将现场观测转化为驱动决定提供明确的指导。

blocks.en: To provide more targeted supervision, recent datasets have increasingly adopted question-answering (QA) and chain-of-thought (CoT) annotations ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Marcu et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ) . QA-based datasets decompose driving scenes into object-level questions, allowing models to learn individual visual concepts. Such supervision enables more fine-grained probing and learning of driving implications of individual elements. However, QA-based supervision primarily trains VLMs to answer isolated questions, providing limited guidance on how multiple pieces of evidence are connected into a coherent and structured reasoning process ( Nie et al., 2024 ) . CoT-based annotations mitigate this limitation by modeling the intermediate reasoning steps, enabling VLMs to learn a coherent driving reasoning chain that connects scene observation, contextual interpretation, and decision-making ( Ishaq et al., 2025 ; Arai et al., 2025 ) . Despite these advances, most existing CoT supervision does not prioritize decision-critical evidence. Consequently, VLMs may incorporate decision-irrelevant elements into their reasoning, resulting in verbose or distracted outputs that compromise both quality and efficiency ( Qian et al., 2025 ) . In addition, current CoT annotations are predominantly textual and rarely ground critical elements to their corresponding visual regions. This missing connection may cause VLMs to rely on language priors rather than the actual scene, producing interpretations that are weakly supported by visual observations and increasing the risk of hallucination ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Chang et al., 2026 ) . Moreover, most existing datasets are dominated by routine driving scenarios and provide limited coverage of long-tail situations.
blocks.zh: 为了提供更有针对性的监督,最近的数据集越来越多地采用问答(QA)和思维链(COT)说明(Wu等人,2025年;Marcu等人,2024年;Qian等人,2024年). 基于QA的数据集将驱动场景分解为对象层次的问题,使模型能够学习个人视觉概念. 这种监督有助于更细致地调查并了解个别因素的驾驶影响。 然而,基于质量保证的监督主要训练VLM来回答孤立的问题,对如何将多件证据与连贯和结构化的推理过程联系起来提供了有限的指导(Nie等人,2024年)。 基于CoT的说明通过模拟中间推理步骤减轻了这一限制,使VLMs能够学习一个连贯的驱动推理链,连接现场观测,背景解释和决策(Ishaq等人,2025年;Arai等人,2025年). 尽管取得了这些进展,但大多数现有的海关总署监督并不优先考虑关键决策证据。 因此,VLM可能会将与决策无关的内容纳入其推理,从而产生影响质量和效率的动词或分散输出(Qian等人,2025年)。 此外,目前的CoT说明主要是文字性的,很少为相应的视觉区域提供关键要素。 这种缺失的连接可能导致VLMs依赖语言前传而非实际场景,产生由视觉观察支持的微弱解释,并增加幻觉风险(谢等人,2025年;张等人,2026年). 此外,大多数现有数据集都以例行驾驶情景为主,对长尾情况的报道有限。

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we introduce AnchorReasoning, a visual grounding and causal reasoning dataset for VLMs in long-tail driving scenarios (Table 1 ). Built upon WOD-E2E ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , AnchorReasoning augments real-world long-tail driving clips with decision-critical visual grounding annotations and driving reasoning chains tailored for VLM training. For each frame, the annotations are organized as a visually grounded chain-of-thought (VG-CoT): observation and grounding, element implication, driving action rationale, and driving action and trajectory planning. First, it guides VLMs to identify and localize decision-critical elements, such as roadway users and traffic control devices. It then enables VLMs to interpret element attributes and infer their implications for ego driving. VLMs then consolidate multiple implications to derive the action plan and future trajectory, while providing a rationale. In addition, we develop a curriculum supervised fine-tuning (SFT) strategy to fully leverage the proposed dataset. The curriculum progressively equips VLMs with visually grounded causal reasoning and planning capabilities through the VG-CoT supervision. We further design a point-based visual-grounding metric to evaluate the localization accuracy of predicted decision-critical elements. Experimental results across different backbones demonstrate that VG-CoT supervision equips models with visual grounding capability, enabling them to incorporate visual evidence into higher-quality reasoning and more accurate trajectory prediction. It improves the Rater Feedback Score (RFS) Frame and Cluster by 1.66 and 1.70. These gains are achieved with 18.5 fewer reasoning tokens on average and a 0.32 s/frame reduction in inference latency. The main contributions of this paper are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 为解决这些局限性,我们引入了AnchorReasoning,这是长尾驱动情景中VLM的视觉定位和因果推理数据集(表1). 建于WOD-E2E(徐等人,2026年),AnchorReasoning增加了真实世界的长尾驾驶片段,配有针对VLM培训的关键性视觉定位说明和驱动推理链. 对于每个框架,说明是按视底思维链(VG-CoT):观察和定位、要素影响、驱动行动理由、驱动行动和轨道规划。 一,指导VLM识别和定位决策关键要素,如道路使用者和交通控制装置. 然后,它使VLMs能够解释元素属性,并推断其对自我驱动的影响. 然后,VLMs巩固了多种影响,以得出行动计划和未来轨迹,同时提供一个理由。 此外,我们制定了一项课程调整战略,以充分利用拟议的数据集。 该课程通过VG-CoT监督,逐步使VLM具备视源因果关系推理和规划能力. 我们进一步设计了一个基于点的视觉定位度量度,以评价预测的决策关键要素的本地化准确性. 跨越不同主干线的实验结果表明,VG-CoT监理使模型具备了视觉地面能力,使其能够将视觉证据纳入更高质量的推理和更准确的轨迹预测. 它改进了Rater反馈分数框架和分组,增加了1.66和1.70。 取得这些成绩的办法是平均减少18.5个推理符号,减少0.32分/帧推断延迟。 本文件的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early language-supervised driving datasets focus on describing driving behavior and explaining action decisions. BDD-X provides natural-language descriptions of driving actions and their justifications ( Kim et al., 2018 ) , while DRAMA further introduces localization of risk-relevant objects together with hazard explanations ( Malla et al., 2023 ) . These works establish language-based supervision for driving scene understanding and behavior explanation.
blocks.zh: 早期语言监督的驱动数据集侧重于描述驱动行为和解释动作决定. BDD-X提供了驾驶动作及其理由的自然语言描述(Kim等人,2018年),而DRAMA则进一步引入了与风险相关的物体的本地化以及危险解释(Malla等人,2023年). 这些作品建立了基于语言的监督驾驶场景的理解和行为解释.

blocks.en: VQA-based datasets provide more structured supervision through targeted questions about driving scenes. NuScenes-QA covers object existence, attributes, states, and spatial relationships ( Qian et al., 2024 ) ; LingoQA extends the scope to localization, anticipation, attention, and action justification ( Marcu et al., 2024 ) ; and Rank2Tell identifies and ranks decision-relevant traffic participants with natural-language explanations ( Sachdeva et al., 2024 ) . DriveLM further introduces Graph VQA, connecting perception, prediction, and planning questions through logical dependencies ( Sima et al., 2024 ) . These datasets support fine-grained learning of object- and task-level driving knowledge.
blocks.zh: 基于VQA的数据集通过有针对性的驾驶场景问题提供更有条理的监督. NuScens-QA涵盖物体的存在、属性、状态和空间关系(Qian等人,2024年);Lingo。 QA将范围扩大到本地化、预期、关注和行动理由(Marcu等人,2024年);以及Rank2Tell用自然语言解释确定与决策相关的交通参与者并排位(Sachdeva等人,2024年)。 驱动 LM进一步引入了图VQA,通过逻辑依赖性将感知,预测和规划问题联系起来(Sima等人,2024年). 这些数据集支持精细的学习对象和任务级驱动知识.

blocks.en: Recent datasets move toward structured reasoning chains for driving. Reason2Drive introduces reasoning across perception, prediction, and decision-making ( Nie et al., 2024 ) , while DriveLMM-o1 provides step-by-step rationales for perception, prediction, and planning ( Ishaq et al., 2025 ) . nuReasoning further extends reasoning supervision to real-world long-tail scenarios with spatial, decision, and counterfactual reasoning ( Huang et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: 3 AnchorReasoning Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 锁定重解数据集

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: AnchorReasoning is a visually grounded reasoning dataset designed to train and evaluate VLM in long-tail scenarios. Built upon WOD-E2E, it augments real-world long-tail driving clips with annotations centered on decision-critical elements. AnchorReasoning identifies and visually grounds the elements that influence the ego driving, and further annotates their attributes and implications. These annotations are organized into a VG-CoT that connects grounding, scene understanding, causal reasoning, action and trajectory prediction. The dataset contains over 11 hours of driving data across 2492 clips, comprising 416,119 annotated frames and 395,379 decision-critical elements.
blocks.zh: AnchorReasoning是一个可视化基于推理的数据集,旨在在长尾情景中训练和评价VLM. 它以WOD-E2E为基础,增加了真实世界的长尾驾驶片段,配有以决定关键要素为中心的说明. AnchorReasoning识别并视同地论证影响自我驱动的元素,并进一步说明其属性和意义. 这些说明被组织成一个VG-CoT,连接地面,场景理解,因果推理,动作和轨迹预测. 数据集包含超过11小时的驾驶数据,数据涵盖2492个剪辑,包括416 119个附加说明的框架和395 379个决定关键要素。

blocks.en: VG-CoT is designed to guide VLMs through a hierarchical and evidence-grounded driving reasoning process. It encourages models to reason from the observed scene instead of relying primarily on language priors, thereby improving reasoning fidelity and reducing hallucinations. VG-CoT first provides scene-level context and event-level traffic information. The context annotations describe global driving conditions (Fig. 3 ), providing the background needed to interpret appropriate driving behavior under different environments. Traffic event annotations further capture events such as roadside parking and construction. These annotations provide event-level constraints that may not be fully represented by individual objects.
blocks.zh: VG-CoT旨在引导VLM通过分级和基于证据的驱动推理过程. 它鼓励模型从观测到的场景中进行推理,而不是主要依赖语言前科,从而改善推理忠心度和减少幻觉. VG-CoT首先提供场景级背景和事件级交通信息. 上下文说明描述了全球驾驶条件(图3),提供了在不同环境下解释适当驾驶行为所需的背景. 交通事件说明进一步捕捉路边停车和施工等事件. 这些说明提供了事件级限制,可能无法由单个对象充分代表.

blocks.en: The core of VG-CoT is the annotation of decision-critical elements, which directs the model toward visual evidence that influences the current driving decision (Fig. 2 ). Each element is annotated with both visual grounding (bounding boxes and segmentation masks), and structured semantic information. We group decision-critical elements into four major categories: vehicles, vulnerable road users (VRUs), obstacles, and traffic-control elements. For vehicles, VRUs, and obstacles, the annotated attributes include type, location, state, intention, and impact rank. Location describes both the relative direction of the element and its road-topological position. State represents the currently observed condition, whereas intention describes the likely short-term behavior, such as turning, or crossing the road. Impact rank indicates the relative priority of each element in the current decision, where a smaller rank number denotes a stronger influence on ego driving. This ranking guides the model to allocate attention among multiple critical elements in a human-like manner. For traffic-control elements, other than the impact rank, the annotations capture information such as traffic-light states, sign semantics, and descriptions of temporary traffic control. Each decision-critical element is further associated with an implication, which explains how the observed element may affect the ego vehicle and what action responses are appropriate. This encourages the model to reason about one critical factor at a time before integrating multiple factors, thereby reducing interference from unrelated information and facilitating the subsequent global reasoning process.
blocks.zh: VG-CoT的核心是对决定关键要素的注释,它引导模型转向影响当前驱动决定的视觉证据(图2 ). 每个元素都附加了视觉地面(边框和分区口罩)和结构化语义信息。 我们把决定关键要素分为四大类:车辆、易受伤害的道路使用者、障碍和交通控制要素。 对于车辆,VRU和障碍物,注释属性包括类型,位置,状态,意图,以及撞击等级. 位置说明元素的相对方向及其道路地形位置. 国家代表目前观察到的状况,而意图则描述可能的短期行为,如转弯或过路。 影响级表示当前决定中每个要素的相对优先性,其中较低级数表示对自负驾驶的影响更大. 这一排名指导模型以类似人的方式在多个关键要素之间分配注意力. 对于交通控制元件,除撞击等级外,注释会捕捉交通灯状态,标志语义等信息,以及对临时交通控制的说明. 每一种决定关键要素都与某种含义有进一步的联系,这说明观察到的要素会如何影响自我的载体,以及应采取何种行动。 这鼓励该模型在整合多种因素之前,先解释一个关键因素,从而减少不相关信息的干扰,并促进随后的全球推理进程。

blocks.en: Finally, the reasoning and planning stage consolidates multiple element-level implications to derive the final driving decision. The rationale weighs these cues according to their relevance and impact, producing longitudinal and lateral actions. Because high-level actions can serve as an intermediate representation between semantic reasoning and continuous trajectory, AnchorReasoning includes both action annotations and future trajectories, supporting models that predict either meta-actions or trajectories directly.
blocks.zh: 最后,推理和规划阶段合并了多个要素层面的影响,得出最后驱动决定。 其理由根据这些提示的相关性和影响加以权衡,产生纵向和横向行动。 由于高阶动作可以作为语义推理和连续轨迹之间的中间代表,AnchorReasoning既包括动作说明,也包括未来的轨迹,支持直接预测元动作或轨迹的模型.

blocks.zh: 图5:预先界定的空间区域。

blocks.en: We adopt a hybrid human-in-the-loop annotation pipeline that combines human judgment, VLM-assisted annotation, promptable segmentation, and rule-based methods. At the scene level, Qwen3-VL generates contextual labels, while human annotators identify traffic events. For decision-critical elements, annotators with driving experience first identify and rank the elements they would prioritize under the same driving situation. To improve consistency, they follow four guidelines: prioritizing traffic-control elements, nearby elements, moving elements, and elements likely to affect the ego vehicle’s future driving space. At most five decision-critical elements are retained per frame to keep the supervision concise. Annotators then provide point prompts for each selected element, which are passed to SAM3 to generate instance masks and corresponding bounding boxes.
blocks.zh: 我们采用混合的人类即时注解管道,结合人的判断,VLM辅助注解,迅速分解,以及基于规则的方法. 在场景层面,Qune3-VL生成背景标签,而人类的注释者识别出交通事件. 对于决策关键要素,具有驾驶经验的注释员首先确定和排列在相同驾驶情况下优先排列的要素。 为了提高一致性,它们遵循了四条准则:优先考虑交通控制因素、附近因素、移动因素以及可能影响自负车未来驾驶空间的因素。 每个框架最多保留五个关键决定要素,以使监督工作简明扼要。 然后,注释员为每个选定的元素提供点提示,这些提示被传递给SAM3生成实例口罩和相应的边框.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Free-text annotation length and action space.
blocks.zh: 图 6:自由文字注释长度和动作空间.

blocks.en: Element attributes are subsequently obtained through human and automatic annotation. Human annotators provide element states and short-term intentions, while Qwen3-VL generates element types, sign content, and temporary traffic-control descriptions. Element location combines manually annotated road-topological relations with zone-based relative directions inferred from bounding-box positions and their overlap with predefined regions (Fig. 5 ). Traffic-light states are determined using Hue–Saturation–Value-based rules within the detected traffic-light regions (Appendix B.2 ).
blocks.zh: 元素属性随后通过人和自动注释获得. 人类注释员提供元素状态和短期意图,而Qune3-VL生成元素类型,标志内容,以及临时流量控制描述. 元素位置将人工附加说明的道路-地形关系与从捆绑框位置推断出的基于区的相对方向及其与预定义区域重叠(图5)相结合。 交通灯状态在检测到的交通灯区使用Hue-Saturation-Value规则确定(附录B.2 ).

blocks.en: Based on these grounded element annotations, implications are generated using a complexity-aware strategy. Scenes with no more than two decision-critical elements are processed using a locally deployed Qwen3-VL, whereas scenes with richer interactions are handled by GPT-5.2. The same strategy is applied to the final reasoning and planning stage. This tiered pipeline can balance annotation quality and cost.
blocks.zh: 根据这些基于要素的说明,采用具有复杂性的战略产生影响。 不超过两个决定关键要素的场景使用当地部署的Qune3-VL处理,而互动较丰富的场景则由GPT-5.2处理. 同样的战略适用于最后推理和规划阶段。 这种分层管道可以平衡注释的质量和成本。

blocks.en: Before large-scale annotation, each automatic annotation tool is evaluated to verify its reliability; the evaluation method and quantitative results are provided in Appendix B . After annotation is completed, we employ a multi-stage quality-control procedure. For context and traffic event annotations, 50% of the samples are randomly reviewed and corrected by human annotators. Decision-critical element selection and impact ranking are further verified through cross-annotation review. Each sample is checked by a second annotator, and substantial disagreements are resolved by a third annotator through majority voting. For long-form annotations, including implications, rationales, and action plans, recurrent error patterns are summarized and used to refine the system prompts, after which the corresponding annotations are regenerated. We additionally apply a rule-based consistency check between action plans and future trajectories to enforce expected geometric and kinematic consistency (Appendix B.6 ). Inconsistent samples are flagged for manual review and correction.
blocks.zh: 在进行大规模注解之前,对每个自动注解工具进行评价,以核实其可靠性;附录B提供了评估方法和定量结果。 注释完成后,我们采用多阶段质量控制程序。 对于上下文和交通事件说明,50%的样本都由人类注释者随机审查和纠正. 通过交叉通知审查进一步核实关键决定要素的选择和影响排名。 每个样本由第二个注释员检查,第三个注释员通过多数表决解决重大分歧。 对于长式说明,包括影响,原理,以及行动计划,反复出现的误差模式进行总结,并用于完善系统提示,之后重新生成相应的说明. 我们还在行动计划与未来轨迹之间实行基于规则的一致性检查,以强化预期的几何和运动一致性(附录B.6)。 标出不一致的样品供人工审查和改正。

blocks.en: 3.4 Dataset Statistics
blocks.zh: 3.4 数据集统计

blocks.en: The dataset contains approximately 395K decision-critical elements across 4 high-level categories and 19 fine-grained element types, providing extensive object-level supervision for identifying driving-relevant evidence. Their grounded locations span the three-camera images and exhibit different spatial distributions across element classes, enabling models to associate heterogeneous visual evidence with its semantic role in driving (Fig. 4 ). The free-text annotations remain compact, with mean lengths of 34 tokens for element-level implications and 32 tokens for rationales, supporting concise inference from individual element effects to integrated driving decisions. Finally, the action space comprises 4 longitudinal and 10 lateral actions, providing semantic planning supervision that connects grounded reasoning with motion planning (Fig. 6 ).
blocks.zh: 该数据集包含大约395K个决定关键要素,涉及4个高级类别和19个精细度元素类型,为识别驾驶相关证据提供了广泛的对象级监督. 它们被定位在三摄像头图像之间,并显示不同元素类别的空间分布,使模型能够将各种视觉证据与其在驾驶中的语义作用联系起来(图4)。 自由文字说明仍然很紧凑,要素层面所涉问题的平均长度为34个符号,基本原理为32个符号,支持从单个要素效应到综合驱动决定的简明推论。 最后,行动空间包括4项纵向行动和10项横向行动,提供语义规划监督,将基于理由的推理与运动规划联系起来(图6)。

blocks.en: 4 Curriculum-Based Supervised Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 4 课程监督 精细的图宁

blocks.en: Stage I focuses on learning visual perception and proceeds in two phases. In phase a a , supervision is limited to scene context, traffic events, and binary decision-critical element presence, establishing coarse scene understanding before element-level reasoning. Phase b b introduces element identification, visual grounding, impact ranking, and attribute understanding. Throughout both phases, the complete VG-CoT target is retained, but locked fields are masked from the loss and contribute no gradient. This preserves a consistent output structure while allowing the model to progressively acquire the capabilities required for finer-grained perception.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段的重点是学习视觉感知,分两个阶段进行。 在a阶段,监管仅限于场景背景、交通事件和二进制决定关键元素的存在,在元素层面推理之前建立粗糙的场景理解。 b阶段引入了元素识别,视觉地面,撞击排名,以及属性理解. 在整个两个阶段,完整的VG-CoT目标都保留下来,但锁定的字段却从损失中蒙住面,没有贡献梯度. 这保持了一致的输出结构,同时使该模型能够逐渐获得更精细的感知所需的能力.

blocks.en: Stage II is initialized from the best Stage-I checkpoint and supervises the complete VG-CoT chain, including element-level implication, driving action rationale, action and trajectory generation. At this stage, the visual encoder is frozen to preserve the grounding capability learned in Stage I while the model learns higher-level reasoning and planning. We additionally apply trajectory-only supervision to a subset of training samples, where only trajectory tokens contribute to the loss, to preserve a direct perception-to-action pathway. We also increase the sampling probability of frames containing longitudinal action transitions and rare element states to improve the coverage of underrepresented cases.
blocks.zh: 第二阶段从最好的第一阶段检查站初始化,并监督完整的VG-CoT链条,包括要素层面的影响、推动行动的理由、行动和轨道生成。 在这个阶段,视觉编码器被冷冻,以保留在第一阶段所学到的地基能力,而模型则学习更高层次的推理和规划. 此外,我们还对只有轨迹标志才造成损失的一组培训样本实施仅轨迹监督,以保持直接的感知至行动路径。 我们还增加了包含纵向行动过渡和稀有要素状态的框架的抽样概率,以提高代表性不足的病例的覆盖面。

blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Models
blocks.zh: 5.1 模式

blocks.en: We evaluate eight representative models to assess the effectiveness of AnchorReasoning across diverse model foundations. (i) General-purpose VLMs. Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Bai et al., 2025b ) and Qwen3-VL-8B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) serve as general-purpose baselines. (ii) Embodied-AI foundation models. Cosmos-Reason2-2B and Cosmos-Reason2-8B ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) provide embodied-reasoning baselines without driving-specific adaptation. (iii) AV-specific VLMs. Alpamayo-R1-10B and Alpamayo-1.5-10B ( Wang et al., 2025 ) are driving-specialized models capable of joint reasoning and trajectory prediction. AutoVLA-3B ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) and Impromptu-VLA-7B ( Chi et al., 2026 ) are included as complementary open-source driving baselines. Detailed training and implementation settings are provided in Appendix C.1 , C.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价了八个代表性模式,以评估不同模式基础的AnchorReason的有效性。 (一) 通用VLMs. Quen2.5-VL-7B(Bai等人,2025b)和Quen3-VL-8B(Bai等人,2025a)作为通用基线。 (二) 健全-AI基金会模式。 Cosmos-Reason2-2B和Cosmos-Reason2-8B(NVIDIA,2025年)提供体现理由的基线,而不采用驱动特性。 (三) 特定反车辆地雷的甚高频。 阿尔帕马约-R1-10B和阿尔帕马约-1.5-10B (Wang等人,2025年)是能够联合推理和轨迹预测的驱动专业模型. AutoVLA-3B(周 al等人,2026年)和Impromptu-VLA-7B(Chi等人,2026年)作为互补的开源驱动基线被包括在内. 附录C.1、C.2提供了详细的培训和实施环境。

blocks.en: 5.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.2 评价计量

blocks.en: We use standard classification, trajectory, and efficiency metrics to evaluate scene understanding, element attributes, trajectory prediction, and inference cost. Context Acc. measures the average accuracy of scene-context predictions, while Traffic Event F1 evaluates the detection of traffic events. Presence Acc. measures whether the model correctly predicts the presence of decision-critical elements in a frame. For matched elements, Element State Recall, Element Intention Recall, and Sign-Content Recall evaluate the corresponding semantic attributes, while R/G Conf. measures the red–green traffic-light confusion rate. For trajectory prediction, we report Average Displacement Error (ADE) and Final Displacement Error (FDE). We additionally report the official WOD-E2E RFS ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . Detailed definitions and implementation protocols are provided in Appendix C.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用标准分类、轨迹和效率衡量标准来评价场景理解、元素属性、轨迹预测和推论成本。 Acc.测量场景-背景预测的平均准确性,而交通事件F1则评价交通事件的发现. Acc. 衡量模型是否正确预测某一框架中是否存在决定关键要素。 对于匹配的元素, Element State Recall, Element Insent Recall, 和 Sign-Content Recall 评估相应的语义属性, 而 R/G Conf 测量红绿交通灯的混淆率 。 关于轨迹预测,我们报告平均流离失所误差和最终流离失所误差。 我们还报告官方的WOD-E2E RFS(徐等人,2026年)。 详细的定义和执行议定书载于附录C.3。

blocks.en: Because the model predicts a point rather than a bounding box, we match predicted elements to ground-truth elements using a one-to-one, scale-adaptive point-to-mask criterion. For each ground-truth element, the point-to-mask distance is zero when the predicted point falls inside its segmentation mask and otherwise equals the minimum Euclidean distance to the mask. A prediction is considered matched when this distance falls within a scale-adaptive assignment threshold determined by the ground-truth element size.

blocks.en: 5.3 Results
blocks.zh: 5.3 结果

blocks.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of VG-CoT supervision, we compare Base and VG-CoT models in scene-level semantics and decision-critical element understanding, reasoning and trajectory prediction, inference latency, and visual-grounding ablation. Base denotes the domain-adapted model trained on the original WOD-E2E data, while VG-CoT denotes the same model trained with VG-CoT supervision from AnchorReasoning. Training details are provided in Appendix C.2 .
blocks.zh: 为了评价VG-CoT监督的有效性,我们比较了Base和VG-CoT模型在场景层面的语义和决定关键元素理解,推理和轨迹预测,推论纬度,以及可视化测距. Base表示在WOD-E2E原始数据上训练的域适应模型,而VG-CoT则表示在AnchorReasoning的VG-CoT监督下训练的同一模型. 培训详情见附录C.2。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Example VG-CoT output of Alpamayo-1.5-10B.
blocks.zh: 图7:阿尔帕马约1.5-10B的示例VG-CoT输出.

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that VG-CoT supervision enables scene- and element-level predictions that are unavailable in several Base models, while improving the ability to identify and understand decision-critical elements. More importantly, the supervision enables models not only to state decision-critical elements in text but also to localize them in the image (Fig. 7 ). For the general-purpose Qwen models and the Cosmos embodied-AI foundation models, the Base models can identify decision-critical elements and their types, but tend to retrieve only a limited number of such elements. For example, Qwen2.5-VL achieves 0.89 Element Type Acc. but only 0.43 Element Recall, while Cosmos-Reason2-2B achieves 0.71 type accuracy but only 0.10 Element Recall. After training with VG-CoT supervision, both Element Recall and Rank-1 Recall increase across these models. Moreover, Rank-1 Recall is higher than overall Element Recall for every trained backbone, indicating that the supervision more reliably captures the elements with the strongest influence on the driving decision. The AV-specific models exhibit different behavior. The Base Alpamayo models already show stronger decision-critical element retrieval than most general-purpose models, but lack explicit grounding and several structured attributes in their native outputs. VG-CoT supervision adds these capabilities; Alpamayo-1.5 reaches 0.92 Point-in-Mask Rate while maintaining strong Element Recall and Rank-1 Recall. In contrast, Alpamayo-R1 attains reasonable Rank-1 Recall but a much lower Point-in-Mask Rate of 0.40, showing that identifying an important element does not necessarily imply precise visual localization. Across all model families, Element Type Acc. and Traffic Control-Content Recall are consistently higher than Element State and Intention Recall, suggesting that dynamic behavior understanding remains more difficult than recognizing element identity and traffic-control semantics under single-frame visual input.
blocks.zh: 表2显示,VG-CoT监督能够使一些基建模型无法提供的场景和元素水平的预测,同时提高识别和理解决定关键要素的能力. 更重要的是,监督使模型不仅能够说明文字中的决策关键要素,而且能够将它们在图像中本地化(图7)。 对于通用的Quen模型和Cosmos 体现的-AI基础模型,Base模型可以识别决定关键元素及其类型,但往往只回收数量有限的此类元素. 例如, Quen2.5- VL 实现了 0.89 元素类型 Acc.但只有0.43 元素召回,而Cosmos-Reason2-2B则实现了0.71类型精度,但只有0.10 元素召回. 在接受VG-CoT监督培训后,这些模式的“元素召回”和“排名1”都有所增加。 此外,排名1 在每个受过训练的骨干骨干中,召回比总的“元素召回”要高,这表明监督更可靠地抓住了对驱动决定影响最大的要素。 AV特定模型表现出不同的行为. 与大多数通用模型相比,Alpamayo基地模型已经显示出更强的决策关键要素检索能力,但在其本土产出中缺乏明确的基础和一些结构化属性。 VG-CoT监督增加了这些能力;Alpamayo-1.5达到0.92 点值率,同时保持强元素召回和Rank-1召回. 与此相反,Alpamayo-R1获得了合理的Rank-1召回,但比0.40的点值率低得多,这表明识别一个重要要素并不一定意味着精确的视觉定位。 在所有示范家庭中,Element Type Acc. 和交通控制-Content recall始终高于Element State and Insent Recall,表明动态行为理解仍然比单帧视觉输入下识别元素身份和交通控制语义更难.

blocks.en: Table 3: Reasoning, trajectory prediction, and inference efficiency.
blocks.zh: 表3:理由、轨迹预测和推论效率。

blocks.en: Table 3 shows that VG-CoT supervision improves both Element Implication and Driving Action Rationale across all model families. Element Implication consistently scores higher than Driving Action Rationale, indicating that understanding the effect of an individual decision-critical element is easier than consolidating multiple factors into a final driving decision.
blocks.zh: 表3显示,VG-CoT监督改进了所有模范家庭的要素影响和驱动行动理由。 要素影响一直比驱动行动理由评分高,表明理解单个决定关键要素的影响比将多个因素合并为最终驱动决定容易。

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablation results on trajectory prediction.
blocks.zh: 表4:轨迹预测偏差结果。

blocks.en: These reasoning gains are accompanied by improved trajectory prediction: ADE/FDE decrease and both RFS metrics increase with VG-CoT supervision. The visual-grounding ablation in Table 4 further shows that VG-CoT consistently outperforms its non-grounded variant across all trajectory metrics for the three evaluated backbones, indicating that visually grounded CoT provides additional benefits for trajectory prediction. Despite the additional reasoning structure, VG-CoT does not require longer outputs. The average output length decreases by 18.5 tokens and latency by 0.32 s/frame while trajectory accuracy improves, suggesting that VG-CoT can provide more compact reasoning without sacrificing planning performance.
blocks.zh: 在取得这些推理成果的同时,还改进了轨迹预测:ADE/FDE减少,在VG-CoT监督下,RFS两个度量衡都有所增加。 表4的目视测地功能还表明,VG-CoT在三个受评价的主干线的所有轨迹测量中,其无目视测地功能的变体的性能始终高于其无目视测地功能,这表明视视测地功能的CoT为轨迹预测提供了额外的好处。 尽管增加了推理结构,VG-CoT不需要更长的产出. 平均输出长度减少18.5个令牌,延迟0.32 s/frame,同时轨迹精度提高,这表明VG-CoT可以在不牺牲规划性能的情况下提供更紧凑的推理.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Our annotations currently cover only the front-left, front, and front-right camera views, leaving side and rear views unannotated. Future work will extend AnchorReasoning to full-surround perception, potentially using trained models to assist annotation. We also lack explicit depth supervision. Since depth and depth change provide important cues for identifying decision-critical elements, future work will incorporate depth estimates to strengthen spatial understanding and reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们的注解目前只覆盖前左,前,前右镜头的视图,使侧和后视图无附加说明. 未来工作将扩大AnchorReasoning,使之包括全面的看法,可能利用经过培训的模型协助注释。 我们还缺乏明确的深度监督。 由于深度和深度变化为确定决策关键要素提供了重要的提示,今后的工作将纳入深度估计,以加强空间理解和推理。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduce AnchorReasoning, a long-tail autonomous-driving dataset for VLMs that provides visually grounded supervision over decision-critical elements, their attributes and implications, driving-action rationale, and action and trajectory planning. Its VG-CoT structure explicitly connects visual evidence with reasoning and planning, while the curriculum SFT strategy enables models to progressively acquire these capabilities. We further introduce an object-size-aware grounding metric for evaluating decision-critical element localization. Experiments across eight general-purpose, embodied-AI, and AV-specific backbones show that VG-CoT supervision improves grounded reasoning and trajectory prediction. Visual-grounding ablations further confirm that CoT with explicit visual grounding benefits trajectory prediction. Across models, VG-CoT reduces 5-s ADE and FDE by 7.84 and 11.86 on average, improves RFS Frame and Cluster by 1.66 and 1.70, and reduces inference latency by 0.32 s/frame with fewer reasoning tokens. These results demonstrate the value of visually grounded, decision-focused supervision for enhancing VLM reasoning and planning in long-tail autonomous driving.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了AnchorReasoning,这是一个用于VLM的长尾自动驾驶数据集,对决定关键要素、其属性和影响、驱动-行动原理以及行动和轨迹规划提供视基监督。 其VG-CoT结构明确将视觉证据与推理和规划联系起来,而课程SFT战略则使模型能够逐渐获得这些能力. 我们进一步引入了用于评估决定关键要素本地化的物体大小认识基准度量。 跨越8个一般用途的实验,内含-AI和AV特定骨干显示,VG-CoT监督改进了有根据的推理和轨迹预测. 视觉地面塌方进一步证实,CoT具有明显的视觉地面收益轨迹预测。 在整个模型中,VG-CoT平均将5s ADE和FDE减少7.84和11.86,将RFS框架和集群改进1.66和1.70,并将推理符号减少0.32 s/frame的推论延迟. 这些结果表明,在长尾自主驾驶中,视线为基础、以决策为重点的监督对于加强VLM推理和规划具有价值。

blocks.en: AnchorReasoning is constructed on top of the Waymo Open Dataset for End-to-End Driving (WOD-E2E) without modifying the original sensor data or dataset splits. We add semantic and reasoning annotations directly to the decoded WOD-E2E frames. Table 5 summarizes the correspondence between our annotations and the decoded WOD-E2E splits.

blocks.en: For the training split, all 415,663 decoded frames from 2,037 segments are annotated. For validation, we annotate the 456 frames for which WOD-E2E provides rater-feedback trajectories. These frames come from 455 of the 479 decoded validation segments and are used for both model evaluation and Rater Feedback Score (RFS) computation. Each frame is associated with three rated candidate trajectories, resulting in 1,368 human-rated trajectories in total. The remaining decoded validation frames are not included in the annotation statistics. The decoded test split is retained for completeness but is not annotated. Overall, AnchorReasoning contains 416,119 annotated frames from 2,492 WOD-E2E segments and 395,379 decision-critical elements.
blocks.zh: 培训分期进行时,2 037个部分的所有415 663个解码框架都附有说明。 为了验证,我们注释了456帧,WOD-E2E提供了测速器反馈轨迹。 这些框架来自479个解码验证段中的455个,用于模型评价和Rater反馈分数计算。 每个帧都与三个被评为候选的轨迹有关,结果总共产生了1,368个人级的轨迹. 其余的解码验证框架不列入注释统计. 解码的测试拆分保留完整,但没有附加说明. 总体而言,AnchorReasoning包含2,492个WOD-E2E段的416,119个附加说明的帧和395,379个决定关键元素.

blocks.zh: A.2 影响分布

blocks.en: The distribution is strongly concentrated at the highest ranks: 67.9% of the annotated elements are assigned rank 1, 25.3% rank 2, 5.6% rank 3, and 1.0% rank 4, while only 0.2% have rank 5 or higher. 93.2% of all decision-critical elements fall within the first two ranks and 98.8% within the first three, as shown in Fig. 8 . This distribution reflects the annotation principle of retaining only elements that materially influence the current driving decision rather than exhaustively labeling all visible objects.
blocks.zh: 分布高度集中在最高级别:67.9%的注解元素被分配到第1级,25.3%被分配到第2级,5.6%被分配到第3级,1.0%被分配到第4级,只有0.2%被分配到第5级或以上. 如图8所示,所有决定关键要素的93.2%属于前两个等级,98.8%属于前三个等级。 这种分布反映了只保留在实质上影响当前驱动决定的要素,而不是详尽地标注所有可见物体的注释原则。

blocks.en: Figure 9 shows the joint distribution of lateral and longitudinal actions. The distribution is naturally imbalanced, with routine lane-keeping action accounting for most frames and more complex lateral maneuvers forming a long tail. Importantly, lateral and longitudinal actions are not independent: the same lateral maneuver can be associated with substantially different longitudinal responses depending on the surrounding constraints and interaction state. The dataset therefore provides supervision not only for recognizing individual actions, but also for learning their joint behavioral structure.

blocks.en: This section describes the automatic tools used to assist dataset annotation and evaluates their reliability before large-scale deployment. To assess annotation quality, we use a manually annotated subset of the dataset as reference and compare the outputs of each automatic tool against the corresponding human labels. The automatic tools are applied independently without access to these reference labels. Because human annotations may themselves contain ambiguity, the reported results measure human–automatic agreement rather than absolute annotation accuracy.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍用于协助数据集注释的自动工具,并在大规模部署前评价其可靠性. 为了评估注释质量,我们使用一个手动附加注释的数据集子集作为参考,并将每个自动工具的输出与相应的人类标签进行比较. 自动工具独立应用,没有这些参考标签. 由于人类说明本身可能含有模糊性,因此所报告的结果衡量的是人类自动协议,而不是绝对的注释准确性。

blocks.en: We use Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct to classify five scene-level attributes from the image: weather, time of day, visibility, scenario type, and road structure. The model receives only the image and a predefined label taxonomy, and returns a structured JSON output containing the predicted value, confidence, and brief visual evidence. To reduce frame-level fluctuations, predictions are further stabilized within each video. Weather and visibility are kept temporally consistent, missing scenario labels are propagated from adjacent frames, and isolated road-structure changes are detected and corrected. blocks.en: B.2 Traffic-Light State
blocks.zh: B.2 交通灯光州

blocks.en: Traffic-light states are determined using a rule-based HSV classifier. For each annotated traffic light, pixels are extracted from its instance segmentation mask rather than the full bounding box to reduce background contamination. RGB pixels are converted to HSV space, and bright pixels with V ≥ 150 V\geq 150 are selected for analysis. If fewer than 10 bright pixels are available, all pixels within the instance mask are used instead. The adopted HSV thresholds are shown in Table 7 . A color is considered detected only when at least 10 pixels satisfy the corresponding thresholds and account for at least 0.5% of the valid pixels.
blocks.zh: 交通灯状态使用基于规则的HSV分类器确定. 对于每个注解的交通灯,像素都从它的实例分割罩中提取,而不是从全边框中提取,以减少背景污染. RGB像素被转换为HSV空间,并选择带有V ≥ 150 V\geq 150的亮像素进行分析. 如果可用亮像素不到10个,则取而代之的是实例遮罩内的所有像素. 采用的HSV阈值见表7。 只有当至少10像素达到相应的阈值,并占有效像素的至少0.5%时,才认为检测到一种颜色.

blocks.en: We compare the automatically determined directional prefix with the human annotation on 4,439 aligned objects. The two annotations agree on 4,369 instances, corresponding to an agreement rate of 98.42%. Most disagreements occur between neighboring spatial regions, such as front and front left , rather than between opposite directions. This indicates that the remaining errors are primarily associated with region boundaries.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了4,439个对齐物体上自动确定的方向前缀和人类注释. 两份说明就4 369个案例达成一致,协议率为98.42%。 多数分歧发生在相邻的空间区域之间,如左前方和左前方,而不是相反方向。 这表明,其余的错误主要与区域边界有关。

blocks.en: B.4 Vehicle Type
blocks.zh: B.4 车辆类型

blocks.en: Vehicle types are classified using Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Each vehicle is cropped from the image using its bounding box with a 20-pixel margin and classified into one of seven categories: Car , Truck , Emergency vehicle , Bus , Construction vehicle , School bus , and Other . The prompt is shown in Fig. 17
blocks.zh: 车辆类型采用Qune3-VL-8B-指令进行分类. 每辆车都使用其20像素边距的边框从图像中裁剪,并分为七类之一: 车 卡车、紧急车辆、公共汽车、建筑车辆、校车和其他车辆。 提示显示于图 17

blocks.en: The classifier is evaluated on 3,720 manually labeled vehicles and agrees with the human annotations on 3,681 instances, yielding 98.95% agreement. The remaining disagreements are concentrated around visually similar vehicle categories, particularly the boundary between cars, pickup trucks, and large van-like vehicles.
blocks.zh: 对3 720辆手动贴标签的车辆进行分类评估,并赞同3 681次的人类说明,获得98.95%的协议。 其余的分歧集中在视同车辆类别,特别是汽车、小卡车和大型面包车之间的界限。

blocks.en: B.5 Reasoning Chain Generation
blocks.zh: B.5 理性链生成

blocks.en: The reasoning chain is generated in two stages. First, an element-level driving implication is generated for each decision-critical element. The inputs include the grounded iamge, scene context, ego state, navigation intent, and the structured attributes of the element. The implication describes how the element affects the ego vehicle’s intended path, available motion, right-of-way, or local maneuver options. Each element is interpreted independently so that its causal effect is established before multiple factors are integrated. Second, the element-level implications are combined with their impact ranks, ego state, and navigation intent to generate a frame-level rationale and final action plan. The rationale integrates the dominant constraints and enabling factors, while the final action plan specifies the resulting short-horizon longitudinal and lateral action. The plan is constrained to the action vocabulary used in AnchorReasoning.
blocks.zh: 推理链分两个阶段生成. 首先,每个决定关键要素都会产生要素层面的驱动影响。 投入内容包括被基于的暹罗,场景背景,自我状态,导航意图,以及元素的结构属性. 其含义是描述该元素如何影响自负飞行器的预定路径、可用的运动、行驶权或当地机动方案。 每个要素都是独立解释的,这样,在整合多个因素之前,就可以确定其因果关系. 第二,要素层面的影响与其影响级、自我状态和导航意图相结合,以产生框架层面的理由和最终行动计划。 该理由综合了主要制约因素和有利因素,而最后行动计划则规定了由此产生的短期纵向和横向行动。 该计划受AnchorReasoning中使用的行动词汇的限制.

blocks.en: To balance annotation quality and computational cost, scenes are routed according to annotation complexity. Simple scenes, defined as those containing at most one decision-critical element or exactly two traffic-control elements, are processed using a locally deployed Qwen3.5-122B model, while more complex scenes are processed using GPT-5.2. All generated implications, rationales, and action plans are subsequently inspected and corrected through a dedicated annotation interface. Consecutive frames with identical annotations may reuse the previous output to improve temporal consistency and reduce unnecessary inference. The complete prompt used for driving implication annotation and rationale is shown in Fig. 17 , 18 .
blocks.zh: 为了平衡注释质量和计算成本,场景根据注释的复杂性进行路由. 简单场景,定义为最多包含一个决定关键元素或完全两个交通控制元素的场景,使用当地部署的Quen3.5-122B模型进行处理,而更复杂的场景则使用GPT-5.2处理. 随后通过专门的注释界面检查和纠正所有产生的问题、理由和行动计划。 带有相同说明的连续帧可能重复使用以前的输出,以提高时间一致性,减少不必要的推论. 图17、图18列出了用于驾驶含义的完整提示和理由。

blocks.zh: B.6 行动-预测一致性检查。

blocks.en: Consistency is checked using the compatibility rules rather than strict category equality. For example, an annotated decelerate action is compatible with a trajectory that decelerates or stops, whereas an annotated stop action is inconsistent with a trajectory that immediately continues at normal speed. blocks.en: Appendix C Training and Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 训练和评价详情

blocks.en: C.1 Hardware and Implementation Details
blocks.zh: C.1 硬件和执行细节

blocks.en: All training and evaluation experiments are conducted on NVIDIA B200 GPUs, with two GPUs used for training. Training uses distributed data parallelism with DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage 2 and bfloat16 precision. FlashAttention-2 is enabled for efficient attention computation, and gradient checkpointing is applied to reduce memory consumption. We use full-parameter fine-tuning for all trainable components without LoRA or other parameter-efficient adaptation methods.
blocks.zh: 所有培训和评价实验都是在NVIDIA B200GPU上进行的,两个GPU用于培训. 训练采用分布式数据平行法,与DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage 2和bfloat16精度. FlashAtthy-2被启用,用于高效的注意计算,并采用梯度检查来减少内存消耗. 我们对所有可训练部件采用全参数微调,不采用LORA或其他参数高效的适应方法。

blocks.en: C.2 Training Configuration
blocks.zh: C.2 培训配置

blocks.en: For both domain adaptation and our Supervised Fine-Tuning(SFT), each sample uses the same input representation: a single panorama stitched from three forward-facing cameras, the ego-vehicle motion history, and the high-level navigation intent. The motion history contains 16 waypoints over the preceding 4 s and is provided as textual input. No temporal image sequence, LiDAR, HD map, or auxiliary prediction head is used.
blocks.zh: 对于域名改编和我们监督的Fine-Tuning(SFT),每个样本都使用相同的输入表示:从三个前置相机缝合的单一全景,自负车辆运动史,以及高水平导航意图. 运动历史包含前4 s 的16个路口,并作为文字输入提供. 不使用时间图像序列,LiDAR,HD映射,或辅助预测头.

blocks.en: For the domain-adapted baselines, training is performed on the original WOD-E2E data without using the additional AnchorReasoning annotations. We preserve each model’s original training objective, output format, and training configuration as much as possible. The input also follows each model’s original formulation, with the only modification being the visual input, which is replaced by a single-frame panorama stitched from three forward-facing cameras. The target output follows each model’s original formulation, such as its native reasoning, action, or trajectory representation, rather than the visually grounded chain-of-thought (VG-CoT) annotation format.
blocks.zh: 对于适合域的基线,培训是在WOD-E2E原始数据上进行的,没有使用额外的AnchorReasoning说明. 我们尽可能保留每个模式的最初培训目标、产出格式和培训配置。 输入还沿用了每个模型的原始配方,唯一的修改是视觉输入,取而代之的是从三台前视相机缝合的单帧全景. 目标产出遵循每个模型的原始表述,如其原生推理、动作或轨迹表述,而不是视网膜思维链式(VG-CoT)注释格式。

blocks.en: Our SFT uses the same input representation but supervises the model with the structured VG-CoT output. Stage I focuses on scene-level semantics and decision-critical element understanding, including traffic events, element presence, element identification, visual grounding, impact rank, and element attributes. Stage II is initialized from the best Stage-I checkpoint and extends the output to the complete VG-CoT chain, including ego-state understanding, element-level implications, driving-action rationale, action planning, motion, and future trajectory.
blocks.zh: 我们的SFT使用相同的输入表示,但用结构化的VG-CoT输出来监督模型. 第一阶段侧重于场景层面的语义和决定关键要素理解,包括交通事件,元素存在,元素识别,视觉地面,撞击级别,以及元素属性. 第二阶段从最好的第一阶段检查站初始化,并将产出扩展到完整的VG-CoT链条,包括自我状态的理解、要素层面的影响、驱动-行动理由、行动规划、运动和未来轨迹。

Stage I starts from the original pretrained or released backbone, whereas Stage II is initialized from the best Stage-I checkpoint. The same optimization settings are used across backbones unless otherwise specified.

blocks.en: C.3 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: C.3 评价计量

blocks.en: We evaluate scene understanding using Context Acc. and Traffic Event F1. Context Acc. is the macro-average accuracy over five scene-context dimensions: weather, daytime, visibility, scenario type, and road structure. Traffic Event F1 measures set-level agreement between predicted and annotated traffic events. Presence Acc. is the frame-level binary accuracy of whether at least one decision-critical element is present. Element State Recall and Element Intention Recall are macro-averaged recall scores over normalized behavior categories for matched vehicles and vulnerable road users. Sign-Content Recall evaluates the semantic content of matched traffic signs using macro-averaged recall over the closed-set control labels. R/G Conf. measures the fraction of red and green traffic lights that are confused with each other; lower values are better.

All predicted trajectories are converted to a common 5 s, 4 Hz evaluation grid before scoring. ADE@1s, ADE@3s, and ADE@5s measure the mean Euclidean displacement error between the predicted and ground-truth trajectories over the corresponding prediction horizons. FDE@5s measures the Euclidean error at the final 5 s waypoint. We further report the official Waymo Rater Feedback Score (RFS) using the released WOD-E2E scoring function and its default parameters.
RFS Frame averages the per-frame RFS over all evaluation frames, whereas RFS Cluster first averages RFS within each official scenario cluster and then averages across clusters, thereby assigning equal weight to different scenario types.
RFS ranges from 0 to 10, with higher values indicating better agreement with human-rated driving trajectories.

Fig. 13 presents representative failure cases.
In Fig. 13 (a), the model incorrectly predicts the state and intention of the vehicle at the front-right. This reflects a limitation of single-frame input: motion-related attributes such as state and intention are difficult to infer reliably without explicit temporal visual cues. Fig. 13 (b) shows a case where the model identifies a decision-critical element in text but fails to ground it correctly in the image. This suggests that semantic recognition and visual localization are not always fully aligned: the model may recognize the relevance of an element from scene context while failing to establish an accurate spatial correspondence, especially for small, partially occluded, or visually ambiguous elements. Fig. 13 (c) shows a more challenging failure in which two human-annotated decision-critical elements are omitted from both the textual prediction and visual grounding. Such disagreement may arise from insufficient geometric supervision. The current annotations do not explicitly provide cues such as object distance, distance change rate, or ego-vehicle dimensions, which are important for determining whether an element constrains the ego vehicle’s future driving space. Incorporating these spatial cues may improve decision-critical element selection in future work.

图13介绍了有代表性的失败案例。
在图13(a)中,模型错误地预测了车辆在前右侧的状态和意图. 这反映了单帧输入的局限性:没有明确的时间视觉提示,很难可靠地推断状态和意图等运动相关属性. 图13(b)显示了一种情况,即模型在文本中确定了决定关键要素,但在图像中未能正确定位。 这表明语义识别和视觉本地化并不总是完全一致:模型可能承认某一要素与场景背景的相关性,同时未能建立准确的空间对应,特别是对于小的,部分的,或视觉模糊的元素. 图13(c)显示一个更具挑战性的失败,即文字预测和视觉地面都省略了两个人为附加说明的决定关键要素。 这种分歧可能源于几何监督不足。 目前的说明没有明确提供诸如物体距离、距离变化率或自负车辆尺寸等提示,这些提示对于确定某一要素是否制约自负车辆的未来驾驶空间十分重要。 纳入这些空间提示可改进未来工作中关键决策要素的选择。

blocks.en: D.2 Successful Cases
blocks.zh: D.2 成功案例

blocks.en: Fig. 14 presents representative successful predictions. In Fig. 14 (a), the model correctly identifies and grounds both the parked bus and the oncoming vehicle. It further captures their different effects on ego driving: the bus constrains the available lateral space, while the oncoming vehicle limits the feasibility of moving further left. These element-level implications are consolidated into a coherent driving rationale and action plan. Fig. 14 (b) illustrates a more complex multi-object interaction. The model correctly identifies and grounds all three decision-critical elements, including the backing vehicle, construction vehicle, and pedestrian, and interprets how each constrains the ego vehicle’s future motion. Their implications are then integrated into the final decision to keep lane and decelerate, producing a trajectory closely aligned with the ground truth. This example shows that VG-CoT can connect multiple visually grounded elements with reasoning and trajectory planning in complex scenes.
blocks.zh: 图14提出了具有代表性的成功预测。 在图14(a)中,车型正确识别和停靠的公交车和即将到来的车辆。 它进一步捕捉了它们对自我驾驶的不同影响:巴士限制了现有的横向空间,而即将到来的车辆限制了进一步左移的可行性. 这些要素层面的影响已合并为一个连贯的驱动理由和行动计划。 图14(b)显示了更为复杂的多对象相互作用。 模型正确识别和论证了所有三个决定关键要素,包括辅助车辆、建筑车辆和行人,并解释了每个工具如何限制自负车辆的未来运动。 然后,它们的影响被纳入最终决定,保持航道和减速,形成与地面真相紧密一致的轨迹。 这个例子表明,VG-CoT可以在复杂的场景中将多个视网膜元素与推理和轨迹规划联系起来.
